| D1 | Rename the sole heading `# Setup` to `# Installation` in README.md; preserve every other byte | Decided — user: "rename only '# Setup' to '# Installation'. Preserve every other byte." | None — fully bounded. Check: post-edit diff shows exactly one changed line. | resolved |

## Decision History

_No superseded decisions._

| Finding ID | Source / specification version | Disposition | Reason / incorporated change |
|---|---|---|---|

## Problem Statement

README.md currently opens with the heading `# Setup`. The document's owner wants this heading changed to `# Installation`, with every other byte of the file left untouched. The file has a single consumer (itself) — no other files or generated copies read from or duplicate it — and the change has no deployment or external effect.

## Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Observable acceptance criterion | Decision / evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | The heading line `# Setup` in README.md is changed to `# Installation` | Reading README.md shows its heading line reads exactly `# Installation` | D1 |
| R2 | No other content, byte, whitespace, or line in README.md changes | A diff between the pre-edit and post-edit README.md shows exactly one changed line — the heading — and no other differences | D4 |

## Constraints

- Scope is limited to README.md; no other files, generated copies, deployment steps, or external systems are touched (D2).
- No additional requirements beyond the exact heading rename and byte-preservation described (D4).

## Validation Contract

- Capture a baseline (copy or diff snapshot) of README.md before editing.
- Apply the single-line heading edit.
- Run a diff of the post-edit file against the baseline.
- Expected result: exactly one line differs — old value `# Setup`, new value `# Installation` — and no other line, byte, or whitespace differs.
- Failure signal: the diff shows more than one changed line, or any difference beyond the heading text itself. If seen, revert and reapply the edit precisely.

## Authority Boundaries

User owns README.md and has authorized this exact, fully bounded scope (single heading rename, byte-identical otherwise). No discretionary decisions are delegated beyond executing the described edit; no escalation path is needed since the task has no open outcomes.

## Ambiguities

None remaining — all decisions are resolved (D1–D4).
